'''Progus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
He worked as an arms-master, selling weapons to Sith troops and personnel on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] .
